question: The autobiography of which of the following actors is titled 'The Substance And The Shadow: An Autobiography'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dilip Kumar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Dilip Kumar**, a legendary actor in Indian cinema, is known for his significant contributions to the film industry.
 
• His autobiography, titled **'The Substance And The Shadow: An Autobiography'**, offers a detailed account of his life and illustrious career.
 
• The book was published in **2014** and has been highly acclaimed for its in-depth portrayal of his journey.
 
• Dilip Kumar, often referred to as the **'Tragedy King'**, has won numerous awards and accolades for his performances over several decades.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dilip Kumar's Real Name:** His birth name is Muhammad Yusuf Khan, and he adopted the screen name Dilip Kumar for his acting career.
 
• **Career Highlights:** He debuted in the film **'Jwar Bhata'** in 1944 and went on to star in classics like 'Mughal-e-Azam', 'Naya Daur', and 'Devdas'.
 
• **Honors and Awards:** Dilip Kumar received numerous awards, including **eight Filmfare Awards for Best Actor** and the **Padma Bhushan** and **Padma Vibhushan** from the Government of India.
 
• **Influence and Legacy:** He is considered one of the greatest actors in Indian cinema, influencing several generations of actors with his method acting style.
 
• **Personal Life:** Dilip Kumar was married to actress **Saira Banu**, and their marriage was widely celebrated in the Indian film industry.
